entry.name: rminus
entry.description: Subtracts the input from a specified value The !- object functions just like the - object, but the inlets' functions are reversed.

arguments.name: value
arguments.description: Sets the initial value, to be subtracted from a number received in the left inlet. Aargument causes the numbers to be subtracted as floats.
